method: Primary sources opened independently with the web tool; version-sensitive claims checked on the current official pages. Paraphrases below identify the narrow claims checked, not a production experiment.

sources.supports: An updating command can wait for a concurrent updater, then re-evaluate its WHERE condition on the updated row. A single conditional decrement is different from a prior unchecked SELECT followed by an unconditional update. This PostgreSQL statement is not proof that a SQLite test exercised PostgreSQL isolation.

Vary selects representations; current response age carries residence time through caches. HTTP freshness, permitted storage and validation are separate rules. Shared-cache s-maxage includes proxy-revalidate behavior; stale reuse requires the applicable protocol or deployment permissions. An HTTP cache directive alone does not force an application's internal cache to read its primary database. Purging one cache is not a global atomic invalidation.

Equal-weight least-request chooses from N available random candidates, with two the documented default. Unequal endpoint weights change the algorithm; the dynamic weight uses active requests and a configured bias. An educational normalized-load scan or local admission gate is not the complete Envoy algorithm.

Endpoint updates and local graceful termination occur asynchronously. Grace periods and protocol-aware shutdown permit in-flight work to complete but do not prove every ingress has already observed a removed endpoint or that cancelling a request reverses a committed business effect.
